description: This file is a shell script used for testing a version control system's diff functionality. It contains test descriptions, source script inclusions, predefined test data, comparison functions, and a series of automated tests to verify diff outputs between different tree states, cache states, and file differences.

methods.name: cmp_diff_files_output
methods.description: A helper function to compare diff output files, normalizing object IDs and filtering out certain lines before comparison.
